firstPlayerRule: The first player to make a trumpet sound and announce themselves as the starting player starts.
clarifications: That player places a character first; other players place characters clockwise.
Regular turns then begin with the same starting player and continue clockwise.
internalEvidence: Publisher-hosted English rulebook page 5 was rendered and read. It explicitly keeps the same starter for initial character placement and regular turns. The title, publisher and designer match inventory BGG 77011. SHA-256: 23d9365d91dac0da2f7d8083109e4c6b43f7a3aea0afc93d8010f2b45379a988. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the exact opening instruction, game identity and edition against the cited rulebook.
uncertainty: No tie procedure is specified for a simultaneous trumpet sound and announcement.
